newsitem.title: USA: NH employers to get cut in state unemployment tax.
newsitem.headline: NH employers to get cut in state unemployment tax.

text.p: For the third time in two years, a majority of New Hampshire employers are expected to receive a reduction in their state unemployment taxes, Gov. Stephen Merrill announced Wednesday.

Merrill released figures Wednesday showing that the 0.5 percent rate cut will result in an initial savings of $8 million over the balance 1996 and will increase the total savings to New Hampshire businesses to $40 million over the next biennium.
The reduction, effective for the fourth calender quarter of 1996, will be the third reduction over the last two years, Merrill said.
The rate reduction is triggered with the unemployment Trust Fund balance, during the entire previous quarter, equals or exceeds $250 million.
As of Sept. 9, the fund balance reached its highest level ever at $283.3 million and has not dropped below the $250 million for the quarter.
